authority: tests/Unit/Architecture/ArchitectureRuleTest.php (14 tests, 17 assertions) plus targeted greps performed in this phase

rule_2_domain_must_not_import.delta_in_this_phase: NONE. Identical before and after; the allowlist did not change.

newly_discovered_enforcement_gap.finding: Domain -> Models is NOT enforced by the architecture test, and 5 Domain files import App\Models.
newly_discovered_enforcement_gap.evidence: The LAYER_IMPORTS forbidden list for 'Domain' is [App\Http, App\Console, App\Infrastructure, App\Application, App\Services, App\Http\Controllers]. App\Models is absent from it, even though the target architecture states Domain must not import Models.
newly_discovered_enforcement_gap.severity: MEDIUM - architecture debt, not a security or financial defect
newly_discovered_enforcement_gap.reason_not_repaired: Adding a Domain->Models ban would make the test RED on 5 files and require either rewriting repository contracts around DTOs (a large, behaviour-sensitive change touching settlement, commission and payment) or expanding the allowlist. Both are out of scope for a migration phase. The test was NOT weakened and no rule was removed.
newly_discovered_enforcement_gap.recommended_next_step: Add 'App\Models' to the Domain forbidden list with an explicit 5-class allowlist, so the debt becomes visible and cannot grow - then remove it class by class by introducing DTO-returning repository contracts.

edges_created_by_this_phase.note: a temporary backward edge; it disappears when AssetService is migrated, per plan order 7

conclusion: Phase 0.18 introduced zero illegal dependencies and zero cycles. It did, however, surface an unenforced Domain->Models rule that the Phase 0.15 debt register did not previously capture.
